integrity: Exact analytic proof plus reproducible independent rational three-state covariance checks; no finite computation is used to infer infinite validity or exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem applies solely to scalar Gaussian targets and additive stationary AR(1) gradient errors independent of adjacent Gaussian thermal increments; independent-fresh-oracle SGLM guarantees cannot be transferred to temporally correlated oracles. Only linear sample means and Gaussian W2 covariance are compared, and no general nonlinear, practical minibatch or runtime claim is made. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Opposite correlation optima and a sharp antithetic accuracy scale for stochastic-gradient Leimkuhler–Matthews sampling
